Subject: Redwood estimate + short recap from today's call

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the materials I promised are attached.

Highlights from our discussion:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping median latency < 200ms for user-facing prompts.
- Typical daily traffic: ~120k tokens across 3 endpoints (chat, summarization, embedding-based search).
- Data controls: ClearHaven will need VPC/private deployment and KMS key management for PII pipelines.

What I'm sending:
- Redwood_Estimate_ClearHaven_v1.pdf (PDF): a capacity-based estimate with cost bands and optional burst capacity.
- workload-profile.csv (CSV): the sample traffic profile we used for the sizing exercise.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 15–20 minute technical run-through to walk through the estimate lines and our recommended config (batching, cache policy, quantization options).
2) If it looks good, we can prep a short mutual action plan to cover procurement and security reviews.

Would you be open to a 15–20 minute session next week? Here’s my booking link: https://calendly.com/connor-redwood/15min

If you'd rather loop your procurement/security lead first, feel free to reply-all and I’ll include our security checklist.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_ClearHaven_v1.pdf (PDF), workload-profile.csv (CSV)
